official_contract.d1_rest_query_schema: POST /accounts/{account_id}/d1/database/{database_id}/query accepts a single query object whose sql supports multiple semicolon-separated statements executed as a batch.
official_contract.foreign_key_deferral: PRAGMA defer_foreign_keys=ON defers checks until the end of the current transaction/batch.
official_contract.statement_limit: 100000 bytes per individual SQL statement; the limit applies to each statement in a batch.

rest_query_probe.batch_sql: PRAGMA defer_foreign_keys=ON; CREATE TABLE probe_a(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, b_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES probe_b(id)); CREATE TABLE probe_b(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, a_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES probe_a(id)); INSERT INTO probe_a VALUES('a','b'); INSERT INTO probe_b VALUES('b','a');
rest_query_probe.conclusion: The D1 REST /query route can apply a PRAGMA-deferred circular-FK script atomically when all statements are sent in one query batch. This is different from the native file-import endpoint, whose importer previously failed the exact dump. This small schema fixture does not prove restoration of the complete production export.
